# M0 final gate — Director assessment

**Verdict: M0_BLOCKED.** The local M0 control implementation and its independent reviews support a local-controls completion assessment, but they do not support an M0 exit or resolution of `STOP-M0-001`.

## Finding disposition

| Finding | Disposition | Basis and retained boundary |
|---|---|---|
| H01, H02, H03, M01, M02 | Locally remediated | Data primitives and Risk's event-derived lifecycle, approval, STOP, current-state and accounting controls are independently covered. Trusted external authority and current-state providers remain required. |
| H04, H05, H06 | Locally remediated | Data lineage/history and Research/Quant exposure, freshness, reproduction and inventory controls reject represented attacks. External source truth, custody, verifier currency and unrecorded access remain outside local proof. |
| R01 | Remediated under verifier assumptions | Independent R01 review validates cumulative authoritative registry checks; a stale or dishonest checkpoint remains a documented trust limit. |
| Q01, Q03 | Closed locally | Independent successors verify all prior-split contamination and completed-time rejection cases. |
| Q02 | Local binding remediated | Structured commitment binding works; identity authentication, key custody and external authority honesty are not locally proved. |
| SR01–SR06 | Closed locally | H-M0-022 and H-M0-024 validate current authoritative assembly, STOP, ledger, exposure and kill controls. |
| SR07, SR08 | Closed locally | H-M0-024 v3 verifies exact experiment binding and semantic liability uniqueness. |

The original and successor Skeptic probes remain preserved. Their non-green historical outcomes are classified in the independent review packages; the current semantic successors and owner suites cover the valid-prerequisite controls. The preserved Research-v1 errors are category-B fixture migrations at the mandatory verifier-history boundary, with v2/v4 successor coverage; they are not unexplained current failures.

## STOP adjudication

The original STOP remains OPEN. `validate_stop_clearance` requires a preserved OPEN STOP, content-bound remediation evidence, descendant revalidation, a verifier-controlled authority policy from an expected external source, and independent typed STOP-clearance attestations for every required domain role (including Risk where capital is implicated). The repository has only schemas and test fixtures for those authority objects. It has no external policy, attestation set, or resolution event. Creating them in this repository would be self-issued evidence, which the Risk contract rejects.

The missing authority/attestation channel must be provisioned outside the candidate evidence set. Then the issuer or an independent substitute, affected domain owners and Risk must issue current, conflict-free typed attestations against an exact resolution event. Director may validate that event and publish a superseding resolved STOP record only after those conditions and descendant revalidation are met.

## Current permissions

The repository may continue documentation, synthetic local-control tests and remediation of the clearance prerequisite. It may not begin M1, activate Scout for real discovery, perform paper activity, connect a venue, authenticate accounts, deposit funds, execute wagers, clear the STOP, or unlock capital.

Capital remains `5000` conceptual minor units, `0` deployable, `0` reserved, `LOCKED`; the kill switch remains `ENGAGED`.
